manager_rule: Maintain a session-scoped variable 'session_min_drc' initialized to positive infinity. After each round R: (1) if round R's structural DRC < session_min_drc, update session_min_drc = round R's structural DRC and record 'session_min_drc_round' = R; (2) if round R's structural DRC > session_min_drc + 15 AND kelvin_unrouted > 0 AND no keepout or ripup spatial intervention was applied in rounds R-3, R-2, or R-1 (inclusive): (a) query all structural DRC violation loci from round R's DRC output; (b) bin loci into a spatial grid with 3mm cells; (c) identify the cell with the highest locus count (the 'regression hotspot'); (d) inject a single 3mm-radius circular keepout centered on the regression hotspot centroid for the immediately following round R+1 only -- do NOT ripup tracks, only restrict future routing in that region; (e) log 'drc_regression_targeted_keepout' with fields: round R, structural DRC for round R, session_min_drc value, session_min_drc_round, regression magnitude (round_R_drc - session_min_drc), regression hotspot centroid and locus count, keepout geometry injected, kelvin_unrouted from round R; (f) do NOT update session_min_drc after a regression event -- session_min_drc tracks the all-time best observed DRC and is only updated when DRC strictly improves below the current minimum. This rule does NOT fire if spatial intervention (keepout or ripup from any rule) was applied in the 3 preceding rounds, to avoid compounding spatial constraints immediately after another intervention. This rule is additive to Rules 47, 48, and 49 and does not modify net_absorption_count, compiler_excluded_nets, consecutive_high_drc_kelvin_stall, or any other session-scoped state maintained by those rules. Rationale: Rules 47/48/49 all require sustained consecutive-round counters at DRC > 20 before triggering spatial intervention, making them responsive to prolonged plateaus but blind to regression events where DRC increases sharply above a prior session minimum in a single step. Round 99's DRC=44 versus a prior observed DRC=19 at round 91 represents a 2.3x regression that does not satisfy any existing rule's counter threshold (the counter may have recently reset if DRC briefly dipped), yet it indicates FR has adopted a routing topology in some spatial region that is strictly worse than a state it previously achieved. A single targeted keepout at the densest DRC locus after a regression event applies minimal constraint (one round, one region) to redirect FR away from the backsliding region without the aggressive ripup that Rules 47/48 reserve for extended stagnation.
